شُمْلُولٌ ; and its pl. شَمَالِيلُ: see شَمَلٌ, in three places. ―
-b2- شَمَالِيلُ also signifies The shoots that divaricate at the heads of branches, like the fruitstalks of the raceme of the palm-tree. (S, O.) ―
-b3- [Hence,] ذَهَبُوا شَمَالِيلَ They went away in distinct parties: (K:) or they dispersed themselves. (S, O.) ―
-b4- And ثَوْبٌ شَمَالِيلُ A garment, or piece of cloth, rent, or slit, in several places; (O, TA;) like شَمَاطِيطُ. (S, O.) ―
-b5- شَمَالِيلُ النوى means بَقَايَاهُ [i. e. The remains of النوى: but I doubt whether this word be correctly transcribed]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
